name: solvesphere-ai
description: SolveSphere AI - Academic & Campus Intelligence Platform (Firebase Architecture)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@solvesphere/shared && npm run build --workspace=@solvesphere/functions && npm run build --workspace=@solvesphere/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@solvesphere/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:unit: node --import tsx --test tests/seed-safety.test.js tests/smoke-ai-parser.test.js tests/bootstrap-admin.test.js tests/ui-structure.test.js tests/real-data-contract.test.js tests/inventory-safety.test.js tests/audit.test.js
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:smoke-ai
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules functions/node_modules apps/*/dist functions/lib
